description: This Java class implements service methods related to share accounts, including validation and retrieval of account details, within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: AccountEntityServiceForShareAccountsImpl
classes.description: Implementation of account entity service specific to share accounts, providing validation and account number retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key representing the account type, in this case, 'SHARES'.

methods.name: validateSelfUserAccountMapping
methods.description: Validates whether the share account ID is correctly mapped to the current authenticated user; throws exception if not.

methods.name: retrieveAccountNumberByAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account number associated with the given account ID.
